name: Customer Support Chatbot
model: Cosine Intent Embedder + Fallback Rule Engine
description: Conversational customer service agent providing FAQ retrieval, context tracking, confidence thresholds, and human handoff routing.
limitations: Cannot understand complex multistep troubleshooting or handle angry customers effectively without human intervention.
responsible_use_notes: Must disclose to customers that they are conversing with an automated bot and provide an immediate human agent escalation button.
